description: Jackdaw is the phone app for a Mantle brain, the self-hosted AI memory you run on your own server. Chat with your assistant, search everything, notes, pages, tasks, journal, files and events. No Mantle server yet? Enter https://demo.mantle-ai.tech on the first screen and sign in with any email and password; the demo is read only.
whatsNew: First public test build. Try: connect to your Mantle (or the demo at https://demo.mantle-ai.tech with any login), chat with streaming replies, search, notes, tasks, files, and push notifications.
